teaser: The smell of coffee going stale on a warm burner lingers before anyone names it. You are a 6, the number called the nurturer, and an INFP, built around quiet conviction and private imagining. In this crossing, care rarely stays plain. It arrives dressed as a cause, and the cause arrives dressed as a feeling about how a home or a friendship ought to look. Other sixes keep a ledger of who owes what warmth to whom. This one keeps a story instead, and the story is rarely finished before someone else's dinner goes cold.
excerpt: The flickering departure board at the far end of a rain-wet platform won't settle on a time, and you stand under it with someone, not arguing, just waiting out the uncertainty together.
